'''Marcel Fernand Neuts''' (21 February 1935 – 9 March 2014) was a Belgian-American mathematician and probability theorist. He is known for contributions in [[algorithmic probability]], [[stochastic process]]es, and [[Queueing theory|queuing theory]].<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Asmussen |first1=Søren |last2=Nielsen |first2=Bo Friis |year=2014 |title=Obituary: Marcel F. Neuts 1935–2014 |journal=Journal of Applied Probability |language=en |volume=51 |issue=4 |pages=895–897 |doi=10.1017/S000186780001185X |s2cid=124685847 |issn=0021-9002 |doi-access=free}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=M. F. Neuts |url=https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/author/37326864000 |access-date=4 June 2023 |website=[[IEEE]]}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Star |first=Classifieds Arizona Daily |date=14 March 2014 |title=Professor Marcel F. Neuts 2/21/1935 3/9/2014 |url=https://tucson.com/lifestyles/announcements/obituaries/professor-marcel-f-neuts-2-21-1935-3-9-2014/article_4da0b786-3d24-5e2b-8f93-c709e2d237c0.html |access-date=28 October 2023 |website=Arizona Daily Star |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Purdue University – Department of Statistics – Marcel Neuts Lectures of the Department of Statistics Purdue University |url=https://www.stat.purdue.edu/news/2015/Marcel_Neuts_Lecture.html |access-date=29 October 2023 |website=stat.purdue.edu}}</ref>

== Education and career ==
Neuts was born in [[Ostend]], Belgium and studied at the [[KU Leuven]]. He moved to the US in 1956 along with his wife Olga. He was admitted to graduate programs at [[Stanford University]] and received his MSc in 1959 and PhD at the same place in 1961, just two years after the MSc degree, under the supervision of [[Samuel Karlin]]. He held positions at [[Purdue University]] from 1962 to 1976, the [[University of Delaware]] from 1976 to 1985, and at the Department of Systems and Industrial Engineering at the [[University of Arizona]] from 1985 until his retirement in 1997.<ref>{{cite book |last=Neuts |first=Marcel F. |contribution=An Algorithmic Probabilist's Apology |date=1986 |url=https://doi.org/10.1007/978-1-4613-8631-5_14 |title=The Craft of Probabilistic Modelling: A Collection of Personal Accounts |pages=213–221 |editor-last=Gani |editor-first=J. |access-date=26 May 2023 |series=Applied Probability |volume=1 |place=New York, NY |publisher=Springer |language=en |doi=10.1007/978-1-4613-8631-5_14 |isbn=978-1-4613-8631-5 |url-access=subscription}}</ref><ref name=informs>{{Cite magazine |doi=10.1287/orms.2014.02.22in |title=In Memoriam – Marcel F. Neuts (1935–2014) |magazine=OR/MS Today |date=7 April 2014 |department=INFORMS News |doi-access=free}}</ref>

== Honors and awards ==
Neuts received the [[Lester R. Ford Award]] from the [[Mathematical Association of America]] in 1969.<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Chakravarthy |first1=Srinivas R. |last2=Dudin |first2=Alexander N. |last3=Krishnamoorthy |first3=A. |last4=Resnick |first4=Sidney I. |year=2011 |title=Foreword |url=http://www.tandfonline.com/doi/abs/10.1080/15326349.2011.619378 |journal=Stochastic Models |language=en |volume=27 |issue=4 |pages=555–568 |doi=10.1080/15326349.2011.619378 |s2cid=219693254 |issn=1532-6349 |url-access=subscription}}</ref> Neuts served as the chairman of the Applied Probability Society of the [[Institute for Operations Research and the Management Sciences]] between 1977 and 1978.<ref name=informs /> He received the Alexander von Humboldt Fellowship in 1983 to conduct research at the [[University of Stuttgart]]. He was the founding editor of the journal [[Stochastic Models]] and a contributing editor for [[Journal of Applied Probability]] and [[Advances in Applied Probability]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=M. F. Neuts, IEEE |url=https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/author/37326864000 |access-date=28 October 2023}}</ref>

The journal Stochastic Models has established a prize after Neuts for best papers published in the journal.<ref>{{Cite journal |date=4 January 2003 |title=Marcel F. Neuts Prize for the Best Paper in Stochastic Models |url=http://www.tandfonline.com/doi/abs/10.1081/STM-120019415 |journal=Stochastic Models |language=en |volume=19 |issue=1 |pages=149 |doi=10.1081/STM-120019415 |s2cid=219697942 |issn=1532-6349 |url-access=subscription}}</ref>
